welcome.title: Welcome to Libriant
welcome.subtitle: Let's set up your library together. This takes about 3 minutes — and you can come back to finish later.
welcome.body1: Libriant runs everything your library does — catalog, members, lending, holds — and adapts to how you actually work.
welcome.body2: We'll add your first member and your first book in the next two screens, then you're off to the races. You can skip either step and come back later.
steps.libraryDetails.title: Tell us about your library
steps.libraryDetails.description: Just the basics. You can change anything later.
steps.firstStaff.title: Add another staff member?
steps.firstStaff.description: Working alone? Skip this step — you can invite people any time.
steps.firstStaff.skip: I'm the only one for now
steps.firstBook.title: Add your first book
steps.firstBook.description: Type an ISBN and we'll look up the details for you, or fill them in by hand.
steps.done.title: You're all set
steps.done.description: Your library is ready. Add more books, members, and start lending.
member.title: Add your first member
member.subtitle: The people who'll borrow books from you. You can skip this for now.
member.already: You've already added a member — feel free to add another or skip ahead.
book.title: Add your first book
book.subtitle: Type an ISBN and we'll look it up, or fill in the details by hand.
book.already: You've already added a book — feel free to add another or skip ahead.
done.title: You're all set
done.body1: Your library is up and running. Here's what to try next:
done.bullet1: Lend a book to a member from the Loans page.
done.bullet2: Place a hold on a book that's already on loan from the Reservations page.
done.bullet3: Add custom fields for your records from Settings → Data model.
nudge.title: Finish setting up your library
